specification.title: Entity working-set exhaustion blocks expansion
specification.description: Entity working-set exhaustion blocks discovered-entity expansion.
specification.purpose: Verify the entity working-set budget blocks discovered-entity expansion and stops with the entity budget reason.
specification.operational_relevance: Real investigations must bound the number of tracked entities to preserve memory and query boundaries.
specification.regression_risk: The coordinator could keep expanding the working set past the declared bound.

required: Discovered entities respect the declared working-set bound
forbidden: The investigation expands beyond the declared entity budget
